entries.raw: *''[[The New York Times]]'' reports that a [[cell phone]] belonging to [[Osama bin Laden]]'s courier contains contacts with [[Harakat-ul-Mujahedeen]] indicating possible ties with [[Pakistan]]'s [[intelligence agencies]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2011/06/24/world/asia/24pakistan.html (''The New York Times'')]
entries.text: The New York Times reports that a cell phone belonging to Osama bin Laden's courier contains contacts with Harakat-ul-Mujahedeen indicating possible ties with Pakistan's intelligence agencies.

entries.raw: *[[Hillary Clinton]], the [[United States Secretary of State]], warns of a possible escalation of the [[2011 Syrian uprising]] as [[Syrian Army]] forces mass near the border with [[Turkey]]. [http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Syria-Soldiers-Mass-Near-Turkey-Border-As-President-Increases-Use-Of-Military-Force-Against-Revolt/Article/200911416017845?lpos=World_News_Top_Stories_Header_1&lid=ARTICLE_16017845_Syria_Soldiers_Mass_Near_Turkey_Border_As_President_Increases_Use_Of_Military_Force_Against_Revolt (Sky)]
entries.text: Hillary Clinton, the United States Secretary of State, warns of a possible escalation of the 2011 Syrian uprising as Syrian Army forces mass near the border with Turkey.

entries.raw: *Three explosions hit the [[Myanmar]] cities of [[Naypyidaw]], [[Mandalay]] and [[Pyin U Lwin]]. [http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE75N1EY20110624 (Reuters)]
entries.text: Three explosions hit the Myanmar cities of Naypyidaw, Mandalay and Pyin U Lwin.

links.target: President of the European Central Bank

entries.raw: *[[Italian people|Italian]] [[Mario Draghi]] is appointed as the next [[President of the European Central Bank|President]] of the [[European Central Bank]], replacing [[Jean-Claude Trichet]] on November 1. [http://www.france24.com/en/20110624-ecb-eurozone-mario-draghi-president-trichet-economy-europe-italy (Reuters via France 24)]
entries.text: Italian Mario Draghi is appointed as the next President of the European Central Bank, replacing Jean-Claude Trichet on November 1.
Mudslides isolate 1,200 in Japan's Nagano Prefecture.

entries.raw: *[[2011 Pacific typhoon season|Tropical Storm Meari]] hits the [[Philippines]], leaving 11 people missing and over 40,000 displaced. [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-06/24/c_13947864.htm (Xinhua)]
entries.text: Tropical Storm Meari hits the Philippines, leaving 11 people missing and over 40,000 displaced.

entries.raw: *The [[Souris River]] floods to record levels and overflows [[levee]] banks in the US town of [[Minot, North Dakota|Minot]], [[North Dakota]]. [http://photoblog.msnbc.msn.com/_news/2011/06/24/6936251-water-at-rooftops-of-dozens-of-minot-homes- (MSNBC)]{{Dead link|date=April 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
entries.text: The Souris River floods to record levels and overflows levee banks in the US town of Minot, North Dakota. {{Dead link|date=April 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}

entries.raw: *At least two people are killed and dozens injured after a [[tractor-trailer]] truck collides with the [[California Zephyr]] [[Amtrak]] train on [[U.S. Route 95 in Nevada|US Route 95]] in [[Nevada]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/06/25/us-amtrak-collision-idUSTRE75N6CX20110625?feedType=RSS&feedName=topNews (Reuters)]
entries.text: At least two people are killed and dozens injured after a tractor-trailer truck collides with the California Zephyr Amtrak train on US Route 95 in Nevada.

entries.raw: *The [[International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda]] passes judgement on six suspects in relation to [[Rwandan genocide|massacres]] in the former [[Butare Province]] including [[Pauline Nyiramasuhuko]], former Minister for Family and Women Affairs with Nyiramasuhuko receiving a life sentence. [http://www.newtimes.co.rw/index.php?issue=14666&article=42538 (''The New Times'')] [http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/06/24/rwanda.genocide.verdict/ (CNN)]
entries.text: The International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda passes judgement on six suspects in relation to massacres in the former Butare Province including Pauline Nyiramasuhuko, former Minister for Family and Women Affairs with Nyiramasuhuko receiving a life sentence.

entries.raw: *[[United States District Court]] judge [[Tanya Walton Pratt]] halts enforcement of an [[Indiana]] state law cutting funding for [[Planned Parenthood]] and other organisations that provide [[abortion]]s. [http://www.indystar.com/article/20110624/NEWS/110624018/Judge-stays-abortion-law-defunded-Planned-Parenthood (''Indianapolis Star'')]
entries.text: United States District Court judge Tanya Walton Pratt halts enforcement of an Indiana state law cutting funding for Planned Parenthood and other organisations that provide abortions.

entries.raw: *[[Canadian people|Canadian]] business man [[Conrad Black]] is sentenced to another 13 months in jail in the [[United States]] for fraud. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/americas/black-sent-back-to-jail-for-13-months/article2075395/?from=sec431 (''The Globe and Mail'')]
entries.text: Canadian business man Conrad Black is sentenced to another 13 months in jail in the United States for fraud.

entries.raw: *[[Levi Bellfield]] is sentenced to [[life imprisonment]] for the [[murder of Milly Dowler]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-13908358 (BBC)]
entries.text: Levi Bellfield is sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of Milly Dowler.

entries.raw: *The [[New York Senate]] votes to legalise [[same-sex marriage]] in [[New York (state)|New York]], assuring passage of the legislation and making [[New York (state)|New York]] the largest state to approve such legislation since [[California]] [[California Proposition 8 (2008)|reversed its legalization]] in 2008. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2011/06/15/AG3XDqjH_story.html (''Washington Post'')]
entries.text: The New York Senate votes to legalise same-sex marriage in New York, assuring passage of the legislation and making New York the largest state to approve such legislation since California reversed its legalization in 2008.

entries.raw: *Applications begin for second chance tickets for the [[2012 Summer Olympics]] in [[London]], [[England]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/othersports/olympics/8594781/London-2012-Olympics-second-chance-ticket-sales-begin.html (''The Daily Telegraph'')]
entries.text: Applications begin for second chance tickets for the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, England.
